--- before/model/Containers/MachineService.design
+++ after/model/Containers/MachineService.design
@@ -1,6 +1,8 @@
 language design-core version 0.6.
+unit CalibrationProcessor.
 container MachineService.
-MachineService owns CalibrateMeasurement.
+CalibrationProcessor owns CalibrateMeasurement.
+MachineService contains CalibrationProcessor.
 MachineService owns PublishMachineBaseline.
 MachineService owns ReduceMachineState.
 MachineService provides AuthoritativeMachineState.
--- before/code/machine.go
+++ after/code/machine.go
@@ -1,5 +1,12 @@
 // Synthetic trial code; this is not Ponsse production code.
 package pilot
 
-func CalibrateMeasurement(raw int) int          { return raw * 2 }
+type CalibrationProcessor struct{}
+
+func (CalibrationProcessor) CalibrateMeasurement(raw int) int { return raw * 2 }
+
+func CalibrateMeasurement(raw int) int {
+	return (CalibrationProcessor{}).CalibrateMeasurement(raw)
+}
+
 func ReduceMachineState(current, delta int) int { return current + delta }
